scenes.props: Chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn tròn mạ crôm, mũ cối xanh sờn, ổ cứng nhỏ màu đen, ghế nhựa thấp và cốc cà phê của các quán, đoàn tàu xanh trắng.
scenes.setting: Hà Nội's narrow train street at noon: railway tracks running between rows of old tube houses, tiny cafés with low stools pulled back from the rails, laundry and potted plants along the walls.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trên phố đường tàu, các quán cà phê vội vàng kéo ghế vào, đoàn tàu đang từ xa lao tới.
clips.camera: 24mm wide low-angle shot along the rails, slow dolly-back
beats: Low between the shining rails, the narrow train street stretches away under the noon sun, laundry fluttering and potted plants lining the old tube-house walls.
Tiny café tables and low plastic stools sit pulled back tight against the walls, coffee cups trembling on the tabletops as the rails begin to hum.
Far in the distance at the end of the street, a single train headlamp glows small and bright, still very far away.
clips.sfx: rails humming and ticking, coffee cups rattling on saucers, a long distant train horn

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Chiếc xe máy cũ băng qua đường ray trong gang tấc, rồi mất hút vào một con ngõ bên kia.
clips.camera: 50mm medium side shot, slow pan following the bike
beats: The empty rails cut across the frame between café stools and potted plants, and far down the track a tiny train headlamp glows in the distance.
@Lam rides the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp briskly across the rails with @Mai holding on behind him, the train still far away.
The bike rolls over the far rail and disappears into a narrow alley on the other side, @Lam's battered green pith helmet bobbing out of sight.
clips.sfx: tires thumping over steel rails, the bike engine buzzing, a distant train horn

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đoàn tàu ầm ầm chạy qua, bốn chiếc xe đuổi theo đành phanh gấp, kẹt cứng ở bên này đường ray.
clips.camera: 28mm wide shot from the café side, slow lateral drift
clips.extras: four debt collectors on motorbikes stopped behind the passing train
beats: A long blue and white train rumbles through the narrow street, its carriages filling the frame and the laundry on the walls fluttering in its wind.
Through the gaps between the passing carriages, four debt collectors on motorbikes wait stopped well back from the rails beside the café stools, engines idling.
The last carriage rolls away and the far side of the tracks stands empty, while the four debt collectors sit frozen on their motorbikes staring across with mouths shut.
clips.sfx: a train rumbling and clattering past, its horn blaring, idling engines sputtering

clips.speaker: @Mai
clips.line: Ông ơi, ông lái xe còn ghê hơn cả trong phim hành động, cháu suýt rơi cả tim!
clips.camera: 40mm medium two-shot, slow push-in
clips.setting: A narrow winding old-quarter alley maze at noon, laundry overhead, tiny doorways, potted plants.
beats: A narrow winding alley in the old quarter glows in noon light, laundry hanging overhead between tiny doorways and potted plants along the walls.
@Lam rolls the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp to a stop, and @Mai on the back seat speaks breathlessly, one hand pressed to her chest.
@Mai closes her mouth, puffs out a breath through her nose and straightens her round glasses, still clutching the small black hard drive in her other hand.
clips.sfx: the engine ticking down, a distant train fading away, a caged bird chirping

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Ba mươi năm trước cả phố này đuổi ông còn không kịp, mấy thằng nhóc ấy ăn thua gì.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on @Lam, slow push-in
clips.setting: A narrow winding old-quarter alley maze at noon, laundry overhead, tiny doorways, potted plants.
beats: @Lam turns his head toward @Mai and speaks with a dry chuckle in his voice, tapping the brim of his battered green pith helmet with one finger.
@Lam keeps speaking calmly, flicking his hand back toward the railway as if brushing away dust, his thick grey eyebrows lifting.
@Lam closes his mouth into a crooked closed-lip grin while @Mai, behind his shoulder, shakes her head with a wide closed-lip smile.
clips.sfx: the idling engine, laundry flapping softly, a neighbor's radio murmuring far away

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lâm bật cười, nhưng ông không biết, trong lúc mình chạy, Hưng đã ra tay ở một nơi khác.
clips.camera: 28mm wide shot, slow crane-up above the alley
clips.setting: A narrow winding old-quarter alley maze at noon, laundry overhead, tiny doorways, potted plants.
beats: The winding old-quarter alley lies quiet in the noon sun, laundry stirring overhead and a cat dozing on a doorstep among potted plants.
@Lam leans back on the seat of the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp and laughs silently, shoulders shaking, lips closed.
The camera rises above tangled wires and tiled roofs as @Lam grows small below, and a gleaming glass tower appears far off on the sunny skyline.
clips.sfx: pigeons fluttering off a roof, wind chimes tinkling, distant traffic

scenes.title: Hổ Bị Mời Về Đồn
scenes.location: Quán bún chả của bà Hoa vắng khách sau giờ trưa; sạp sửa đài của ông Khoa; nhà ông Lâm.
scenes.axis: Quán: bếp than bên trái khung hình, bàn inox bên phải, lối ra phố ở hậu cảnh. Sạp: kệ đài bên trái, bàn làm việc bên phải. Nhà: bàn gỗ bên trái, cửa cuốn mở ra phố bên phải.
scenes.props: Tập đơn chỉ có dòng chữ mờ không đọc được, tạp dề đỏ, mũ rộng vành đen, bếp than và xiên chả, sạp sửa đài bị lục tung, chiếc đài gỗ Liên Xô cũ, điện thoại sáng liên tục, vệt sơn đỏ trên cửa cuốn.
scenes.setting: Bà Hoa's bustling bún chả shop on an old-quarter street by day: charcoal grills smoking on the pavement, low plastic stools, steel tables, baskets of fresh herbs, warm sunlight through the smoke.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Chiều hôm ấy, hai cán bộ công an bước vào quán bún chả, trên tay là đơn tố cáo lừa đảo của Hưng.
clips.camera: 35mm wide shot, slow dolly-back through the smoke
clips.extras: two police officers in green uniforms walking calmly into the shop
beats: Charcoal grills smoke on the pavement in front of the bún chả shop, low plastic stools and steel tables empty after lunch, baskets of fresh herbs glowing in warm sunlight.
Two police officers in green uniforms walk calmly into the shop through the drifting smoke, one holding a slim folder of papers with faint unreadable lines.
The two officers stop politely beside a steel table and wait with relaxed shoulders, looking toward the grills as smoke curls lazily in the sunlight.
clips.sfx: charcoal crackling, pork sizzling, calm footsteps, a distant street vendor calling

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà Hoa không chạy, cũng không cãi, bà thong thả tháo tạp dề, đội mũ rộng vành rồi đi theo họ.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in
beats: A charcoal grill glows beside a steel table lined with skewers of pork, and a wide-brimmed black hat hangs on a hook on the wall above.
@BaHoa unties her red apron with unhurried calm, folds it neatly and lays it on the steel table beside a basket of fresh herbs.
@BaHoa lifts the wide-brimmed black hat from its hook, settles it on her burgundy curls and glances toward the doorway with closed red lips and a cool half smile.
clips.sfx: charcoal popping, fat sizzling, fabric rustling, a gold bangle clinking

clips.speaker: @BaHoa
clips.line: Các chú cứ từ từ, để tôi tắt bếp than đã, kẻo cháy hết mẻ chả của khách.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow pan with her to the grill
beats: @BaHoa raises one palm toward the doorway off-frame and speaks in a breezy brassy voice, unhurried, as if chatting with regular customers.
@BaHoa keeps speaking as she turns to the grill, slides its little vent shut and moves the last skewers of pork onto a plate.
@BaHoa closes her mouth, dusts off her hands, straightens her hat and strolls out toward the street on her own, chin held high.
clips.sfx: a metal vent scraping shut, coals hissing, sandals tapping on the pavement

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cùng lúc ấy, sạp sửa đài của ông Khoa bị lục tung, chiếc ổ cứng đen trên bàn đã biến mất.
clips.camera: 28mm wide shot, slow dolly-in under the staircase
clips.setting: A tiny electronics repair stall tucked under a staircase in an old-quarter alley: shelves of old radios and phones, tangled wires, a soldering iron, a magnifier lamp, a single bare bulb.
beats: The tiny repair stall under the staircase lies ransacked, drawers hanging open, old radios knocked askew, and a clean dust-free rectangle on the workbench where something used to sit.
@Khoa steps in under the bare bulb and stops short, his magnifier glasses on his forehead, staring at the empty rectangle on the workbench.
@Khoa's eyes flick for a split second to an old wooden Soviet-era radio still untouched on the top shelf, and his lips press into a thin line.
clips.sfx: a bare bulb buzzing, a loose wire ticking against a shelf, distant alley chatter

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Còn điện thoại của Mai sáng liên tục, bọn chúng đã gửi ảnh cô cho cả lớp, kèm hai chữ con nợ.
clips.camera: 50mm close-up, slow push-in
clips.setting: Morning inside Lâm's narrow old-quarter tube house: a ground-floor room with the rolling steel shutter raised, a worn wooden table, a small family altar, sunlight from the street.
beats: A phone lies face-up on the worn wooden table, its blank screen lighting up again and again as it buzzes in a slow circle across the wood.
@Mai picks up the buzzing phone, its blank glowing screen lighting her face, and her thumb freezes above it as it keeps vibrating in her hand.
@Mai lowers the phone slowly, her round glasses reflecting its endless flashing glow, her lips pressed tight and her chin trembling.
clips.sfx: a phone vibrating nonstop against wood, notification pings stacking up, street noise outside

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Mai ngồi sụp xuống bậc cửa còn vệt sơn đỏ, ôm mặt khóc không thành tiếng.
clips.camera: 35mm wide shot, slow crane-down to the doorstep
clips.setting: Morning inside Lâm's narrow old-quarter tube house: a ground-floor room with the rolling steel shutter raised, a worn wooden table, a small family altar, sunlight from the street.
beats: @Mai walks to the open doorway, where faded red paint still stains the edge of the raised steel shutter and the front step.
@Mai sinks down onto the paint-stained doorstep, sets the phone face-down beside her and covers her face with both hands.
@Mai's shoulders shake without a sound as warm street sunlight falls across her lavender hoodie and the stained shutter edge above her.
clips.sfx: muffled motorbikes passing, a soft shaky breath, the phone buzzing faintly on the step

scenes.title: Đêm Trên Sân Thượng
scenes.location: Sân thượng một ngôi nhà ống trong phố cổ, nhìn ra biển mái ngói và mặt hồ xa.
scenes.axis: Hai ông cháu ngồi trên hai ghế nhựa thấp quay ra phố: ông Lâm bên trái khung hình, Mai bên phải; bể nước inox và chậu cây phía sau.
scenes.props: Hai ghế nhựa thấp, bể nước inox, chậu cây, mũ cối xanh sờn đặt trên đầu gối ông Lâm, điện thoại của Mai chỉ phát sáng.
scenes.setting: A tube-house rooftop in the old quarter at night: potted plants, a steel water tank, a sea of tiled roofs and warm city lights, a lake glowing in the distance.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm ấy, hai ông cháu ngồi trên sân thượng, nhìn xuống phố cổ lấp lánh mà chẳng ai nói câu nào.
clips.camera: 24mm wide shot from behind, slow crane-up
beats: A tube-house rooftop glows under warm city lights at night, potted plants and a steel water tank beside two low plastic stools, the lake shimmering far away.
@Lam and @Mai sit side by side on the low stools facing the glittering old quarter, his battered green pith helmet resting on his knee, her hands tucked into her hoodie sleeves.
Neither of them moves, both with lips closed, as the camera rises over the sea of tiled roofs toward the distant lake glowing in the dark.
clips.sfx: a soft night breeze, distant motorbike horns, a dog barking far off, wind chimes

clips.speaker: @Mai
clips.line: Tại cháu mà bà Hoa bị bắt, ông ơi, hay mình trả tiền cho nó rồi thôi đi ông.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow arc to their faces
beats: @Mai turns toward @Lam and speaks in a small cracked voice, her round glasses reflecting the city lights, her fingers twisting her hoodie sleeves.
@Mai keeps speaking and leans her shoulder against @Lam's arm, her eyes glistening as she looks up at him.
@Mai falls silent and closes her mouth, lowering her head, while @Lam looks out at the city with his jaw set.
clips.sfx: the night breeze, faint traffic below, a distant boat horn on the lake

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Ông trả nó một đồng, thì ngày mai nó lại gài thêm trăm đứa khác khổ như con.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on @Lam, slow push-in
beats: @Lam shakes his head gently and speaks in a calm husky voice, his cloudy left eye catching the warm city lights.
@Lam keeps speaking as he rests a warm hand on @Mai's head, his thick grey eyebrows drawn low and steady.
@Lam closes his mouth and keeps his hand on her head, gazing out over the glittering rooftops with a firm, quiet jaw.
clips.sfx: a soft breeze rustling potted leaves, a distant traffic hum, crickets

clips.speaker: @Mai
clips.line: Hưng livestream mỗi tối, có hai triệu người xem, nó thích khoe khoang hơn cả thích tiền.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow dolly-in on @Mai
beats: @Mai lifts her phone, its screen glowing blank, and speaks quickly with a sniff, tapping its edge with one finger.
@Mai keeps speaking and holds the phone up high in a showy livestreamer pose, rolling her eyes with a wry twist of her lips.
@Mai stops and closes her mouth, lowering the phone, while @Lam turns his head sharply toward her with his eyebrows rising.
clips.sfx: a phone buzzing faintly, the night breeze, distant horns

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lâm khựng lại, rồi bật cười, đôi mắt mờ đục của ông bỗng sáng lên như ba mươi năm trước.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in to his eyes
beats: The steel water tank and potted plants on the rooftop glint under warm city light, the glowing lake shimmering beyond the sea of tiled roofs.
@Lam freezes on his stool, then his shoulders begin to shake with a silent closed-mouth laugh, his thick grey eyebrows lifting.
@Lam's narrow eyes, even the cloudy left one, light up with a sharp sparkle reflecting the city lights as a sly grin spreads with lips closed.
clips.sfx: a soft breathy laugh through the nose, wind chimes tinkling, distant traffic

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Thế thì mình để chính cái miệng nó tự khai, trước mặt hai triệu người, con ạ.
clips.camera: 35mm medium two-shot, slow lateral track
beats: The sea of tiled roofs glitters with warm city lights under the night sky, the lake glowing in the distance beyond the potted plants.
@Lam turns to @Mai with a sly glint and speaks low and steady, tapping his own lips with one finger and then pointing out at the city.
@Lam closes his mouth and nods once, while @Mai straightens her round glasses and breaks into a slow closed-lip grin.
clips.sfx: the night breeze, a far-off train horn, wind chimes tinkling

scenes.title: Ổ Cứng Cải Lương
scenes.location: Trước cổng đồn công an phường trên con phố rợp bóng cây.
scenes.axis: Cổng sắt và tường vàng bên trái khung hình, gốc cây và xe máy ông Lâm bên phải; bà Hoa và ông Khoa đứng bên trái, ông Lâm bên phải.
scenes.props: Chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn tròn mạ crôm, mũ cối xanh sờn, chiếc đài gỗ Liên Xô cũ kẹp dưới nách ông Khoa, mũ rộng vành đen, quạt nan.
scenes.setting: Morning at the front gate of a ward police station on a leafy street: mustard-yellow walls, an open iron gate, a tall tree, parked motorbikes.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm sau, cánh cổng đồn công an phường mở ra, bà Hoa bước ra, son môi vẫn đỏ chót.
clips.camera: 28mm wide shot, slow dolly-back from the gate
beats: Morning sunlight filters through a tall tree onto the mustard-yellow walls of the ward police station, the iron gate standing open and motorbikes parked along the curb.
@BaHoa strolls out through the open gate in her wide-brimmed black hat and purple floral blouse, her red lipstick bright and perfect.
@BaHoa stops on the pavement, stretches her arms lazily toward the sky and fans her face with one hand, lips closed in a pleased smile.
clips.sfx: birds chirping in the tree, an iron gate creaking, morning street traffic

clips.speaker: @BaHoa
clips.line: Tôi chỉ nói chuyện đầu tư, có cầm của ai đồng nào đâu mà giữ được tôi hả ông!
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow push-in
beats: The old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp stands parked under the tall tree outside the mustard-yellow police station wall.
@BaHoa walks up to @Lam waiting beside the motorbike and speaks with a brassy laugh in her voice, flicking her fingers open to show empty palms.
@BaHoa closes her red lips with a proud sniff, while @Lam, in his battered green pith helmet, shakes his head with a quiet closed-lip chuckle.
clips.sfx: birds chirping, leaves rustling, a passing motorbike

clips.speaker: @Khoa
clips.line: Cái ổ cứng thằng Béo lấy chỉ là ổ giả, trong đó toàn băng cải lương của tôi thôi.
clips.camera: 85mm over-the-shoulder shot past @Lam onto @Khoa, slow push-in
beats: Parked motorbikes line the leafy street beside the open iron gate, sunlight dappling the mustard-yellow wall through the leaves of the tall tree.
@Khoa, with an old wooden Soviet-era radio tucked under one arm, leans toward @Lam and speaks in a dry deadpan voice, wagging one finger.
@Khoa closes his mouth and adjusts the magnifier glasses on his forehead, while @Lam stares at him with his thick grey eyebrows raised.
clips.sfx: tree leaves rustling, a distant scooter horn, sparrows chirping

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Thế ổ thật ông giấu ở đâu? Đừng bảo là ông lại nhét vào cái đài Liên Xô nhé.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow arc around them
beats: @Lam squints at @Khoa and speaks with a dry, suspicious smile, tilting his head toward the wooden radio under @Khoa's arm.
@Lam keeps speaking, pointing one finger at the old wooden Soviet-era radio and narrowing his calm eyes under the battered green pith helmet.
@Lam closes his mouth and folds his arms, waiting, as @Khoa hugs the radio a little tighter against his ribs.
clips.sfx: leaves rustling, birds chirping, a motorbike puttering past

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Khoa nháy mắt, vỗ vỗ chiếc đài gỗ cũ kẹp dưới nách, bên trong là toàn bộ bằng chứng thật.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow tilt-down from his face to the radio
beats: @Khoa gives @Lam a slow exaggerated wink, lips pressed shut, the morning sun gleaming on his bald crown.
@Khoa pats the old wooden Soviet-era radio under his arm twice with his long fingers, its woven speaker cloth and worn knobs catching the light.
@Lam's thick eyebrows rise slowly into a closed-lip grin, as @Khoa taps the side of his nose with one finger.
clips.sfx: two hollow knocks on wood, sparrows chirping, a soft breeze

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà Hoa nheo mắt cười, lần này, đến lượt Hưng bị bộ ba già dắt mũi.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in
beats: The tall tree sways over the open iron gate of the police station, sunlight sparkling through its leaves onto the mustard-yellow wall.
@BaHoa narrows her sharp eyes under her wide-brimmed black hat and curls her red lips into a sly closed smile, gold hoop earrings swinging.
@BaHoa flicks open a woven bamboo hand fan with a snap and fans herself slowly, eyes glinting toward the city like a tiger eyeing its next meal.
clips.sfx: a fan snapping open, birds chirping, rustling leaves, distant traffic

scenes.title: Ông Già Xe Ôm Đến Trả Nợ
scenes.location: Tổng đài công ty Phú Quý trên tầng cao tòa tháp kính về đêm, phòng sếp vách kính có ring light; chiếc xe tải trắng đỗ dưới chân tòa nhà.
scenes.axis: Trong phòng sếp: Hưng và ring light luôn ở bên phải khung hình, ông Lâm và cửa thang máy ở bên trái. Trong xe tải: Mai ngồi bên trái, ông Khoa bên phải.
scenes.props: Điện thoại gắn gimbal tự sướng của Hưng (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), ring light, mũ cối xanh sờn của ông Lâm, ghế xoay mạ crôm, ổ cứng nhỏ màu đen, hai laptop phát sáng trong xe tải.
scenes.setting: Night in the loan app call center high in the glass tower: rows of desks with glowing monitors, magenta and gold neon accent lights without letters, city lights beyond the windows, a ring light glowing in the glass-walled boss room.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tám giờ tối, như thường lệ, Hưng bật đèn livestream, hai triệu người đang chờ ông chủ Phú Quý lên sóng.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot slow dolly-in
beats: The glass-walled boss room at night, a white leather sofa and a dark ring light on its stand, the magenta and gold neon of the call-center floor glowing beyond the glass, no person in frame.
@Hung strides in and clicks on the ring light, which blooms into a bright white circle, then lifts a phone on a small selfie gimbal to arm's length, lips pressed into a cocky closed-mouth grin.
@Hung smooths his ash-blond undercut in the blank glowing phone screen, straightens his gold-rimmed glasses and poses chin-up, the white ring reflected in both lenses.
clips.sfx: ring light switch clicking on, soft electronic hum, office air conditioning, a few faint notification chimes

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đúng lúc ấy, cửa thang máy mở, ông Lâm bước ra, mũ cối trên đầu, một mình, tay không.
clips.camera: 24mm low-angle wide shot slow push-in
beats: Low wide view down the long aisle of the night call center toward closed brushed-steel elevator doors, blank monitors glowing on both sides under magenta and gold neon, nobody in the aisle.
The elevator doors slide open with a soft chime and @Lam steps out alone, wearing a battered green pith helmet and his faded grey windbreaker, both hands empty at his sides.
@Lam walks slowly up the aisle toward the camera between the glowing monitors, plastic sandals scuffing the carpet, calm narrow eyes fixed ahead and lips closed.
clips.sfx: elevator chime, steel doors sliding open, sandals scuffing on carpet, rows of monitors humming

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Cậu Hưng, tôi đến trả nợ cho cháu tôi, nhưng cậu phải nhận tiền trước mặt người xem.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot slow push-in
beats: Inside the glass-walled boss room at night, the ring light glowing beside the white leather sofa and the glass door standing open onto the neon call-center floor, no person in frame.

Over @Hung's shoulder on screen-right, @Lam stands in the open glass doorway on screen-left and speaks in a calm husky voice, face and lips clearly visible, one finger tapping the brim of his pith helmet.
@Lam finishes, closes his mouth and waits without blinking, while @Hung, gimbal still raised, cocks one eyebrow with a silent closed-mouth smirk.
clips.sfx: ring light hum, distant keyboard clicks, the glass door settling on its hinge

clips.speaker: @Hung
clips.line: Cả nhà ơi, ông già xe ôm đến trả nợ này, xem ông ấy có quỳ xuống xin không nào!
clips.camera: 35mm medium two-shot slow arc
beats: @Hung swings the phone on its small selfie gimbal toward @Lam, the blank screen glowing, and starts talking loudly into it like a livestream salesman, face and lips clearly visible.
@Hung finishes his taunt with a flourish of his ringed hand toward @Lam, then closes his mouth in a smug grin, holding the gimbal steady.
@Lam stands perfectly still in the doorway on screen-left, helmet on and empty hands relaxed, while @Hung on screen-right waits for him to kneel.
clips.sfx: ring light hum, a rising flurry of notification chimes, distant city traffic far below

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lâm không quỳ, ông kéo ghế ngồi xuống, bình thản như đang ngồi quán trà đá đầu ngõ.
clips.camera: 28mm wide shot gentle lateral glide
beats: The glass-walled boss room under the white ring light, a chrome swivel chair standing empty in front of a wide glass desk with a small teapot and cups, neon spilling over the floor, no person in frame.
@Lam walks into frame, pulls the chrome chair out with one hand and sits down unhurried, crossing one leg over the other, lips closed.
@Lam rests his pith helmet on his knee, pours himself a small cup of tea and leans back easily, a faint knowing smile on closed lips, like an old man at a street tea stall.
clips.sfx: chair wheels rolling on the floor, leather creaking, tea trickling into a small cup, ring light hum

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Dưới chân tòa nhà, trong xe tải trắng, Mai gõ phím như bay, ông Khoa đã cắm sẵn ổ cứng thật.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot slow dolly-in
beats: Inside the parked white van at night, two laptops glowing blank on a fold-out desk among tangled cables and a thermos, neon reflections sliding over the tinted windows, no person in frame.
@Mai on screen-left types at lightning speed, round glasses lit by the glow, while @Khoa on screen-right clicks a small black hard drive into the side of a laptop.
@Khoa gives a closed-mouth wink and a thumbs-up, and @Mai nods once without looking up, lips pressed together, both faces lit by the blank glowing screens.
clips.sfx: rapid keyboard clatter, a plug clicking into a port, a soft confirmation beep, muffled street traffic outside

scenes.title: Buổi Livestream Định Mệnh
scenes.location: Phòng sếp vách kính của Hưng trong tổng đài Phú Quý về đêm, và chiếc xe tải trắng dưới chân tòa nhà.
scenes.axis: Ông Lâm ngồi ghế crôm bên trái khung hình, Hưng cầm gimbal đứng bên phải dưới ring light. Trong xe tải: Mai ngồi bên trái trước laptop.
scenes.props: Điện thoại gắn gimbal (màn hình chỉ nhấp nháy ánh sáng, không chữ), ring light, ghế xoay crôm, chén trà nóng và mũ cối xanh sờn trên bàn kính, laptop phát sáng trong xe tải.
scenes.setting: Night in the loan app call center high in the glass tower: rows of desks with glowing monitors, magenta and gold neon accent lights without letters, city lights beyond the windows, a ring light glowing in the glass-walled boss room.

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Cháu tôi vay năm triệu, ba tháng thành trăm rưỡi, cậu tính lãi bao nhiêu một ngày thế?
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot slow push-in
beats: The glass-walled boss room at night, the ring light glowing over a wide glass desk with a steaming teacup beside a chrome chair, the call-center floor beyond bathed in magenta and gold neon, no person in frame.
@Lam sits calmly in the chrome chair on screen-left, pith helmet on his knee, and asks in a husky steady voice, face and lips clearly visible, while @Hung on screen-right films him with the gimbal.
@Lam closes his mouth and tilts his head patiently, while @Hung lowers the gimbal an inch and lets out a closed-mouth scoff.
clips.sfx: ring light hum, distant keyboard clicks, a faint notification chime

clips.speaker: @Hung
clips.line: Ba phần trăm một ngày, không trả thì tôi gửi ảnh cho cả họ hàng nó, luật nào cấm được tôi?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up slow push-in
beats: @Hung leans into the gimbal lens and starts talking loudly and smugly, face and lips clearly visible in the white ring light.
@Hung wags three ringed fingers in the air as he finishes, then closes his mouth in a cocky grin, his gold-rimmed glasses flashing.
@Hung spreads his hands wide and raises his chin toward the lens, while @Lam sits motionless at the soft-focus edge of frame on screen-left.
clips.sfx: ring light hum, notification chimes multiplying, a leather chair creaking

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Cậu nói to lên một chút nữa, để hai triệu người đang xem cùng nghe cho rõ.
clips.camera: 35mm over-the-shoulder shot slow arc
beats: Over @Hung's shoulder, @Lam sits in the chrome chair and speaks calmly up at him, face and lips clearly visible, one weathered hand gesturing gently toward the glowing gimbal phone.
@Lam finishes with a slow nod and closes his mouth, his calm narrow eyes holding @Hung's gaze.
@Hung freezes with the gimbal half-raised and his grin slipping, while @Lam leans back and folds his arms with a closed-mouth smile.
clips.sfx: ring light hum, a sudden flood of notification chimes, the distant drone of the city

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Mai bấm nút, buổi livestream của Hưng bị chia đôi, một nửa là danh sách nạn nhân thật lấy từ máy chủ.
clips.camera: 50mm extreme close-up slow pull-back
beats: Extreme close-up of a laptop keyboard inside the parked white van at night, the blank screen's glow pulsing over the keys beside tangled cables and a thermos, no person in frame.
@Mai's finger presses the enter key firmly and the blank screen glow flares brighter, flooding her round glasses as the camera pulls back to her face.
@Mai leans back in her seat with a tight closed-mouth smile, the laptop light pulsing across her face and neon sliding over the tinted window behind her.
clips.sfx: a single decisive key click, a rising electronic chime, rapid soft beeps, muffled street traffic
clips.setting: Inside a parked white van turned into a surveillance post at night: two laptops glowing, tangled cables, a thermos, tinted windows with neon reflections.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Điện thoại của Hưng rung liên hồi, bình luận chửi rủa trôi như thác, số người xem vọt lên năm triệu.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up slow push-in
beats: Close on the white ring light and the empty white leather sofa in the boss room at night, the neon of the call center pulsing through the glass wall, no person in frame.
@Hung steps into the ring light holding the gimbal as the phone buzzes nonstop in his hand, its blank screen flickering rapid white and red light across his face.
@Hung's cocky grin freezes stiff on his closed lips, a bead of sweat sliding down his temple as the flicker keeps strobing over his gold-rimmed glasses.
clips.sfx: a phone buzzing nonstop, a torrent of rapid notification pings, ring light hum

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hắn quay sang, ông già xe ôm vẫn ngồi đó, nhấp một ngụm trà, mỉm cười như chưa có chuyện gì.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot slow rack focus
beats: @Hung slowly lowers the buzzing gimbal, its blank screen still flickering, the frozen grin fading on his closed lips.
@Hung turns his head toward screen-left and stares off-frame, swallowing hard, his ringed fingers loosening on the gimbal handle.
Focus shifts to the glass desk in the foreground, where a small teacup still steams beside a battered green pith helmet, while @Hung stands motionless in soft focus behind it.
clips.sfx: phone buzzing, a teacup set gently on glass, a slow contented sip, ring light hum

scenes.title: Đế Chế Sụp Đổ
scenes.location: Tổng đài Phú Quý về đêm: nhân viên lần lượt bỏ về, sàn văn phòng trống dần, phòng sếp vách kính và thang máy cuối lối đi.
scenes.axis: Lối đi chính chạy từ thang máy (cuối khung hình) về phía phòng sếp (gần máy quay). Ở cửa phòng sếp: Hưng bên phải, Béo bên trái.
scenes.props: Tai nghe bỏ lại trên bàn, ghế trống còn xoay, màn hình sáng trống, điện thoại của Béo chỉ phát sáng, chén trà cạn, mũ cối xanh sờn.
scenes.setting: Night in the loan app call center high in the glass tower: rows of desks with glowing monitors, magenta and gold neon accent lights without letters, city lights beyond the windows, a ring light glowing in the glass-walled boss room.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trong phòng gọi điện, từng nhân viên tháo tai nghe, lặng lẽ đứng dậy bỏ về, không ai muốn dính vào nữa.
clips.camera: 24mm wide shot slow crane-up
beats: Wide view of the night call center, rows of desks with blank glowing monitors under magenta and gold neon, young callers in headsets sitting stock-still at their screens.
One by one the young callers pull off their headsets, lay them on the desks and stand up, picking up their bags with mouths closed.
The callers walk out in a quiet line between the desks toward the elevator, leaving rows of empty chairs slowly turning under the glowing monitors.
clips.sfx: headsets clattering softly onto desks, chairs rolling back, quiet footsteps, a distant elevator chime
clips.extras: young callers pulling off their headsets and walking out between the desks

clips.speaker: @Hung
clips.line: Ngồi xuống hết! Đứa nào bước ra khỏi cửa là tao trừ hết lương, nghe chưa?
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot handheld slow push-in
beats: The emptying call-center floor at night, abandoned headsets on the desks and chairs left askew under blank glowing monitors, magenta neon pulsing, no person in frame.
@Hung bursts out of the glass boss-room door into the aisle and yells toward the empty elevator at the far end, face and lips clearly visible, one ringed hand raised high.
@Hung closes his mouth and stands panting alone in the empty aisle, satin bomber jacket rumpled, staring at the rows of abandoned chairs.
clips.sfx: a glass door swinging open, a lone chair slowly spinning, monitor hum, a distant elevator chime

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Béo chạy vào, mặt cắt không còn giọt máu, tay cầm điện thoại đang phát lại chính buổi livestream của đại ca.
clips.camera: 28mm wide shot fast tracking dolly
beats: The long aisle of the night call center, empty chairs and blank glowing monitors on both sides, the steel elevator doors standing open at the far end, no person in frame.
@Beo charges up the aisle from the elevator, his heavy frame bouncing and flip-flops flapping, clutching a phone whose blank screen flickers in his hand.
@Beo skids to a stop, face drained pale and shiny with sweat, small eyes wide and closed lips trembling, holding the glowing phone out in front of him.
clips.sfx: heavy running footsteps, flip-flops flapping, wheezing breath, a phone buzzing

clips.speaker: @Beo
clips.line: Đại ca ơi, cả mạng đang chia sẻ, công an kinh tế đang lên tận đây rồi!
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot slow push-in
beats: The doorway of the glass-walled boss room at night, the ring light still glowing over the white leather sofa, magenta neon reflected in the glass, no person in frame.
Over @Hung's shoulder on screen-right, @Beo stands in the doorway on screen-left holding up the glowing phone and blurts out the news, face and lips clearly visible, gold front tooth flashing.
@Beo closes his mouth and wipes the sweat off his shaved head, while @Hung's shoulders stiffen and his ringed hand tightens around the gimbal.
clips.sfx: panting breath, a phone buzzing nonstop, ring light hum, a distant siren far below

clips.speaker: @Hung
clips.line: Gọi hết anh em ra chặn cổng, tuyệt đối đừng để lão già ấy ra khỏi tòa nhà này!
clips.camera: 85mm close-up slow push-in
beats: @Hung turns sharply to @Beo and starts barking orders, face and lips clearly visible, his gold-rimmed glasses catching the white ring light.
@Hung finishes, pointing a ringed finger toward the elevator, then closes his mouth and breathes hard through his nose, a vein standing out on his neck.
@Beo nods rapidly and scurries out of frame, leaving @Hung alone in the ring light, jaw clenched and lips pressed tight.
clips.sfx: ring light hum, a phone buzzing, hurried flip-flop footsteps fading away

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lâm đứng dậy, đội lại mũ cối, thong thả bước vào thang máy như một ông khách vừa uống xong chén trà.
clips.camera: 35mm medium tracking shot
beats: A small empty teacup on the glass desk beside the chrome chair in the boss room, the ring light glowing, the deserted call-center floor visible beyond the glass, no person in frame.
@Lam rises from the chrome chair, settles a battered green pith helmet on his head and tugs his windbreaker straight, lips closed in a calm smile.
@Lam strolls unhurried down the empty aisle into the waiting elevator, turns to face the camera and gives a small nod as the steel doors slide shut.
clips.sfx: a teacup set down on glass, unhurried sandal footsteps, elevator chime, doors sliding closed

scenes.title: Phố Cổ Đứng Dậy
scenes.location: Con phố rộng trước tòa tháp kính về đêm; người phố cổ kéo đến đứng kín hai bên vỉa hè.
scenes.axis: Lối vào tòa tháp ở giữa khung hình, vòng xe máy của đàn em đỗ cách cửa kính vài mét. Xích lô và người phố cổ đứng dọc hai vỉa hè trái phải; không ai lại gần ai, không ai chạm vào ai.
scenes.props: Hai chục xe máy đen đèn pha chói, hàng chục chiếc xích lô, quạt nan của bà Hoa, mũ cối xanh sờn của ông Lâm.
scenes.setting: Night on the wide street in front of the glass tower: neon reflections on the asphalt, tall trees, parked motorbikes, warm streetlamps.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Dưới sảnh, hai chục đàn em của Béo rồ ga chắn kín lối ra, đèn xe chói lòa cả một góc phố.
clips.camera: 18mm high wide shot slow crane-down
beats: High wide view of the night street in front of the gleaming glass tower, neon reflections rippling on the asphalt under warm streetlamps and tall trees.
Twenty young debt collectors in black roll their motorbikes into a wide half-circle a few meters in front of the tower's glass doors, revving engines, faces hidden in shadow.
Their headlights flare into a wall of white glare across the glass doors as exhaust haze curls up through the neon light.
clips.sfx: a chorus of revving motorbike engines, horns blaring, exhaust rumbling, engines settling into an idle
clips.extras: twenty young debt collectors in black on motorbikes revving and blocking the tower entrance

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lâm bước ra một mình, đứng giữa vòng vây, không lùi một bước, chỉ khẽ nâng vành mũ cối lên.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot slow orbit
beats: The glass doors of the tower lobby at night, bathed in the white glare of many motorbike headlights shining from the darkness several meters away, exhaust haze drifting, no person in frame.
The glass doors part and @Lam walks out alone into the glare, pith helmet on and hands empty, and stops in the middle of the pavement.
@Lam stands perfectly still inside the distant ring of headlights and slowly lifts the brim of his battered green pith helmet with one finger, calm narrow eyes steady and lips closed.
clips.sfx: idling motorbike engines all around, glass doors sliding apart, one horn honk dying away, wind in the trees

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Rồi từ hai đầu phố, hàng chục chiếc xích lô chậm rãi đạp tới, những bác xích lô già của phố cổ.
clips.camera: 24mm aerial drone slow descending glide
beats: Aerial view down the long neon-lit street, warm streetlamps and tall trees lining both sidewalks, the white glare of the motorbike half-circle burning in front of the glass tower.
From both ends of the street, dozens of cyclos pedaled by old drivers in faded shirts and conical hats roll in slowly side by side, bells tinkling.
The cyclos glide to a quiet stop in two long lines along the curbs at a respectful distance, the old drivers sitting upright on their saddles, mouths closed and faces calm.
clips.sfx: dozens of cyclo bells tinkling, bicycle chains clicking, thin wheels rolling over asphalt, motorbike engines falling quiet
clips.extras: dozens of cyclos pedaled by old drivers rolling in from both ends of the street

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Các bà bán hàng, các ông xe ôm, cả dãy phố lần lượt bước ra, đứng kín vỉa hè, không ai nói một lời.
clips.camera: 35mm medium tracking shot along the sidewalk
beats: Along the neon-lit sidewalk, the doors of small shops and tea stalls swing open one after another under warm streetlamps.
Old-quarter shopkeepers in aprons and motorbike-taxi drivers in pith helmets step out and line the pavement side by side, arms folded, mouths closed.
The silent crowd stands unmoving along the whole length of the sidewalk, faces lit by neon and streetlamps, every gaze turned toward the glass tower.
clips.sfx: shop doors creaking open, shuffling sandals, a dog barking once, then a deep hush over idling engines
clips.extras: old-quarter shopkeepers and motorbike-taxi drivers stepping out and lining the pavement in silence

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đi đầu là bà Hoa, tay phe phẩy quạt nan, nhìn lũ đàn em như nhìn mẻ chả sắp cháy.
clips.camera: 85mm medium close-up slow tracking shot
beats: The neon-lit sidewalk under tall trees at night, streetlamp light pooling on the paving stones and exhaust haze drifting through the white glare, no person in frame.
@BaHoa strides into frame at the head of the crowd, waving a woven bamboo hand fan in slow lazy strokes, red lips pressed together, gold hoop earrings swinging.
@BaHoa stops, lowers her chin and narrows her sharp eyes toward screen-right with a closed-mouth smirk, fanning herself like a cook eyeing a grill about to burn.
clips.sfx: the soft flap of a bamboo hand fan, heeled sandals clicking, idling engines sputtering

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Béo nhìn quanh, đám đàn em lần lượt dắt xe lùi lại, rồi từng đứa một lặng lẽ chuồn mất.
clips.camera: 28mm wide shot slow push-in
beats: The wide street in front of the glass tower at night, neon reflections on the asphalt and the white glare of motorbike headlights burning beneath the tall trees.
@Beo stands in the middle of the street turning his shaved head left and right, small eyes darting toward the silent crowds lining both sidewalks, lips pressed shut.
Behind @Beo, the young debt collectors quietly walk their motorbikes backward, then turn and slip away one by one into the side streets, leaving him alone in the glare.
clips.sfx: motorbike engines cutting off one by one, tires rolling softly backward, footsteps fading, a lonely cricket chirping
clips.extras: young debt collectors walking their motorbikes backward behind him

scenes.title: Siêu Xe Kẹt Giờ Tan Tầm
scenes.location: Hầm xe tòa tháp kính, rồi đại lộ Hà Nội giờ tan tầm buổi tối; cây cầu sắt bên sông ở cuối đường.
scenes.axis: Dòng xe chảy từ trái sang phải khung hình; siêu xe đỏ kẹt giữa dòng, ông Lâm luồn lách từ phía sau tiến lên; cây cầu sắt ở phía xa bên phải.
scenes.props: Xe thể thao đỏ thấp không logo, chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn pha tròn mạ crôm, mũ cối xanh sờn, điện thoại của Hưng chỉ phát sáng.
scenes.setting: Evening rush hour on a wide Hà Nội avenue: a dense river of motorbikes and cars, red taillights, neon and streetlamps, trees along the sidewalks.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hưng chạy xuống hầm, nhảy lên chiếc xe thể thao đỏ, rú ga phóng ra cửa sau tòa nhà.
clips.camera: 35mm medium tracking shot
beats: A dim underground car park with concrete pillars and flickering fluorescent strip lights, a low red sports car with no badge parked alone with its paint gleaming, no person in frame.
@Hung runs in between the pillars clutching his glowing phone, flings the car door open and drops into the low driver's seat, mouth clamped shut.
The headlights snap on and the red sports car roars off toward the exit ramp, its taillights streaking red through the empty car park.
clips.sfx: hurried sneaker footsteps on concrete, a car door thudding shut, a high-pitched engine roar, tires squealing
clips.setting: A dim underground car park with concrete pillars and fluorescent strip lights, a low red sports car with no badge.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nhưng đây là Hà Nội giờ tan tầm, chiếc siêu xe đỏ chói chỉ nhích được vài mét giữa biển xe máy.
clips.camera: 35mm top-down aerial drone slow descent
beats: Top-down aerial view of a wide Hà Nội avenue at evening rush hour, a dense river of motorbikes crawling under neon and streetlamps, red taillights glowing.
In the middle of the motorbike river, a low red sports car with no badge sits wedged in place with its tinted windows dark, inching forward a hand's width at a time while scooters stream around it.
The camera sinks toward the gleaming red hood as an old scooter loaded with a tall tower of potted flowers putters past the stranded sports car, whose hazard lights blink helplessly.
clips.sfx: a sea of beeping scooter horns, idling engines, a sports car engine revving uselessly, one long comic honk
clips.extras: a dense crowd of evening commuters on motorbikes in helmets and face masks, seen from above

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Phía sau, ông Lâm trên chiếc xe máy cũ lách qua dòng xe như cá lội, mỗi lúc một gần hơn.
clips.camera: 50mm medium tracking shot alongside
beats: Close on a narrow gap between rows of idling motorbike taillights and chrome mirrors on the jammed avenue, neon and streetlamps blurring in the background, no person in frame.
@Lam threads into the gap on the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp, his battered green pith helmet low, slipping between the lanes like a fish through reeds.
@Lam glides past the stalled commuters with steady hands, eyes fixed ahead and lips closed, the round chrome headlamp throwing a warm beam through the traffic.
clips.sfx: an old engine puttering steadily, a cheerful little horn beep, a sea of idling engines
clips.extras: evening commuters on motorbikes stalled around him, faces hidden by helmets and face masks

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hưng bỏ lại siêu xe giữa đường, ôm điện thoại cắm đầu chạy bộ về phía cây cầu sắt bên sông.
clips.camera: 24mm wide shot slow pan
beats: A low red sports car with no badge stands stranded at the edge of the jammed avenue with its engine running, red taillights glowing all around it, no person in frame.
The driver's door swings open and @Hung scrambles out onto the tree-lined sidewalk, clutching his glowing phone to his chest, satin bomber jacket flapping.
@Hung sprints away along the sidewalk past the trees toward a distant steel truss bridge lit by sparse lamps, white sneakers flashing and mouth clamped shut.
clips.sfx: a car door swinging open, a chorus of honking horns, sneakers pounding the pavement, ragged panting

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Chạy bộ lên cầu mà đòi thoát Lâm Rồng à, thằng nhóc này còn non lắm.
clips.camera: 50mm close-up tracking shot
beats: Close on the round chrome headlamp and cream front fender of an old step-through motorbike idling at the edge of the jammed avenue, neon reflections sliding over the chrome, no person in frame.

@Lam, seated on the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp, gazes ahead toward the distant bridge and says this to himself with a dry chuckle, face and lips clearly visible.
@Lam closes his mouth, tugs the strap of his battered green pith helmet tight and twists the throttle with a small sly grin.
clips.sfx: an old engine puttering, distant horns, a helmet strap buckle clicking, the motorbike revving

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cây cầu sắt trăm tuổi, nơi ba mươi năm trước Lâm Rồng từng làm mưa làm gió, đêm nay lại chứng kiến một cuộc rượt đuổi.
clips.camera: 24mm aerial drone slow forward glide
beats: Aerial view of a century-old steel truss railway bridge spanning a wide dark river at night, its rusty iron lattice lit by sparse lamps.
The drone glides along the bridge's long iron spine, the narrow motorbike lane beside the tracks glowing under the lamps and city lights shimmering on the far bank.
The camera settles over the empty middle span, lamplight pooling on the rails as river mist drifts through the iron beams.
clips.sfx: wind whistling through iron girders, the river lapping far below, distant city traffic
clips.setting: Night on a century-old steel truss railway bridge over a wide dark river: rusty iron lattice beams lit by sparse lamps, a narrow motorbike lane beside the tracks, city lights on the far bank.

scenes.title: Trên Cây Cầu Sắt
scenes.location: Giữa cây cầu sắt trăm tuổi bắc qua sông rộng về đêm, trên làn xe máy hẹp cạnh đường ray.
scenes.axis: Ông Lâm luôn ở bên trái khung hình (phía đầu cầu vừa tới), Hưng ở bên phải (phía giữa cầu, ánh đèn công an xanh đỏ nhấp nháy xa sau lưng hắn). Hai người cách nhau vài bước, không ai chạm vào ai.
scenes.props: Chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn pha tròn mạ crôm, mũ cối xanh sờn cầm trên tay, hình xăm rồng xanh sẫm trên cẳng tay phải ông Lâm, điện thoại gắn gimbal của Hưng.
scenes.setting: Night on a century-old steel truss railway bridge over a wide dark river: rusty iron lattice beams lit by sparse lamps, a narrow motorbike lane beside the tracks, city lights on the far bank.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hưng chạy đến giữa cầu thì khựng lại, phía bên kia, đèn xe công an đã chắn kín lối xuống.
clips.camera: 35mm medium tracking shot
beats: The narrow motorbike lane beside the tracks on the old steel truss bridge at night, rusty iron beams lit by sparse lamps and the far end lost in darkness, no person in frame.
@Hung runs into frame along the motorbike lane, panting, phone clutched to his chest, then skids to a halt in the middle of the span.
@Hung stares ahead with his mouth clamped shut as blue and red lights start flashing far away at the end of the bridge, sealing the way down, no figures visible.
clips.sfx: sneakers pounding on iron plates, ragged panting, a distant police siren whooping softly, wind through the girders

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Phía sau, tiếng xe máy cũ chậm rãi dừng lại, ông Lâm dựng xe, tháo mũ cối cầm trên tay.
clips.camera: 24mm low-angle wide shot slow push-in
beats: Low view down the motorbike lane of the old steel truss bridge, a warm round headlamp approaching slowly out of the dark between the rusty iron beams, no person visible.
The old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp rolls to a gentle stop and @Lam sets it on its stand, swinging one leg off the seat.
@Lam lifts the battered green pith helmet off his grey crew cut and holds it at his side, standing tall under a bridge lamp with lips closed and calm eyes forward.
clips.sfx: an old engine puttering to a stop, the metal clack of a side stand, wind through the iron beams, a distant siren

clips.speaker: @Hung
clips.line: Ông là cái thá gì mà dám chơi tôi? Ông chỉ là một lão già chạy xe ôm thôi!
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot slow push-in
beats: The middle span of the old steel truss bridge at night, sparse lamps glowing on the rusty iron lattice and blue and red lights flickering far away at the end, no person in frame.
Over @Lam's shoulder on screen-left, @Hung spins around a few steps away on screen-right and yells at him, face and lips clearly visible, ash-blond hair wind-tossed and glasses askew.
@Hung closes his mouth, chest heaving, clutching his glowing phone, while @Lam stands still on screen-left holding the pith helmet at his side.
clips.sfx: wind howling through iron girders, ragged breathing, the river rushing below

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lâm không trả lời, ông chậm rãi xắn tay áo, con rồng xanh sẫm hiện ra dưới ánh đèn cầu.
clips.camera: 85mm low-angle close-up slow tilt-down
beats: @Lam meets @Hung's stare without a word, lips closed, the bridge lamp above casting a warm halo over his grey crew cut as the wind ripples his windbreaker.
The camera tilts down as @Lam slowly rolls up his right sleeve fold by fold, his weathered fingers steady in the lamplight.
A coiled dark-green dragon tattoo stands revealed along @Lam's bare right forearm, its scales gleaming under the bridge lamp, while @Hung stops dead in soft focus beyond it, lips pressed shut.
clips.sfx: wind whistling through the iron lattice, the soft rustle of a rolled sleeve, the deep rumble of the river, one distant temple bell

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Bố cậu chưa kể hết à? Ba mươi năm trước, phố cổ này là của Rồng, giờ vẫn thế.
clips.camera: 35mm medium two-shot slow arc
beats: @Lam lowers his tattooed arm to his side and speaks to @Hung in a calm husky voice, face and lips clearly visible, the bridge lamp glowing behind him.
@Lam finishes with a slow nod and closes his mouth, the dark-green dragon tattoo still bare on his forearm, as the camera arcs to frame both men several steps apart.
@Hung takes a shaky step back on screen-right, lips pressed tight and knuckles white around his phone, while @Lam stands unmoving on screen-left under the lamp.
clips.sfx: wind through the iron girders, the river rushing below, distant sirens drawing closer

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hưng lùi lại, chiếc điện thoại tuột khỏi tay rơi xuống dòng sông, nhưng năm triệu người đã kịp thấy hết.
clips.camera: 24mm wide shot slow crane-down
beats: The rusty iron railing of the old steel truss bridge at night, the wide dark river glittering far below with the reflected city lights, no person in frame.
@Hung backs up to the railing and a phone on a small selfie gimbal slips from his trembling fingers, tumbling over the edge with its blank screen still glowing.
The glowing phone spins down through the dark and vanishes into the river with a tiny splash, while @Hung leans on the railing above, staring down with his mouth shut.
clips.sfx: a sharp gasp, the clatter of a gimbal on iron, a faint distant splash, wind and rushing water

scenes.title: Kẻ Đòi Nợ Bị Đòi Nợ
scenes.location: Cây cầu sắt về đêm; văn phòng Phú Quý trống trơn; sân trường đại học và nhà ông Lâm sáng hôm sau.
scenes.axis: Trên cầu: công an đi tới từ bên trái, Hưng đứng bên phải cạnh lan can, không ai chạm vào ai. Ở nhà: Mai bên trái, ông Lâm bên phải bàn gỗ.
scenes.props: Đèn xanh đỏ nhấp nháy xa, điện thoại chỉ phát sáng, chén trà, mũ cối xanh sờn, bàn gỗ cũ, bàn thờ nhỏ.
scenes.setting: Night on a century-old steel truss railway bridge over a wide dark river: rusty iron lattice beams lit by sparse lamps, a narrow motorbike lane beside the tracks, city lights on the far bank.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hai cán bộ công an bước tới, Hưng tự giơ hai tay lên, gương mặt kiêu ngạo giờ trắng bệch như tờ giấy.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot slow dolly-in
beats: The middle span of the old steel truss bridge at night, blue and red lights washing softly over the rusty iron lattice and the empty motorbike lane, no person in frame.
@Hung stands alone by the railing on screen-right as two police officers in green uniforms walk up calmly from screen-left and stop a few steps away, hands relaxed at their sides.
@Hung slowly raises both his own hands to shoulder height, ringed fingers spread, face drained pale and lips pressed shut, while the officers wait without moving.
clips.sfx: calm footsteps on iron plates, a police radio crackling softly, wind through the girders, the river below
clips.extras: two police officers in green uniforms walking up calmly

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ở văn phòng Phú Quý, Béo Đầu Sấm ngồi bệt dưới sàn, ôm điện thoại, mếu máo như đứa trẻ lạc mẹ.
clips.camera: 28mm wide shot slow lateral dolly
beats: The deserted call-center floor at night, rows of empty desks and blank glowing monitors under magenta and gold neon, headsets scattered across the desks, no person in frame.
@Beo sits slumped on the floor between the desks hugging his glowing phone to his chest, his closed lips wobbling into a pout like a lost child.
A police officer in a green uniform stands calmly nearby with hands behind his back as @Beo sniffles and wipes his eyes with his wrist, fake-gold chain glinting.
clips.sfx: a loud sniffle, monitor hum, a police radio crackling softly, the whine of the air conditioner
clips.setting: Night in the loan app call center high in the glass tower: rows of desks with glowing monitors, magenta and gold neon accent lights without letters, city lights beyond the windows, a ring light glowing in the glass-walled boss room.
clips.extras: a police officer standing calmly nearby

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm sau, ứng dụng Phú Quý bị khóa, hàng nghìn sinh viên được xóa nợ, nhiều đứa ôm nhau khóc giữa sân trường.
clips.camera: 35mm aerial drone slow descending glide
beats: Aerial view of a sunny university schoolyard in the morning, tall trees casting dappled shade over the paving and old yellow buildings with green shutters all around.
Groups of students gather under the trees staring down at their phones, the blank screens glowing, then slowly lift their heads and turn to one another.
The students wrap each other in silent tearful hugs, lips pressed together and eyes wet, as sunlight falls through the leaves over the whole schoolyard.
clips.sfx: birdsong, rustling leaves, soft sniffles, a chorus of phone chimes
clips.setting: A sunny university schoolyard in the morning with tall trees and old yellow buildings.
clips.extras: groups of students looking at their phones and hugging each other

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Mai mở điện thoại, lần đầu sau ba tháng, không còn cuộc gọi lạ nào, chỉ có tin nhắn cảm ơn của bạn bè.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up slow push-in
beats: Morning inside the narrow tube house, sunlight from the street pouring through the raised steel shutter onto the worn wooden table, a phone lying face-down on it, no person in frame.
@Mai sits down at the table, turns the phone over and looks at its softly glowing screen, her round glasses catching the light as she holds her breath.
@Mai lets out a long breath, eyes glistening behind her glasses, a closed-mouth smile spreading across her face as she presses the phone to her chest.
clips.sfx: gentle message chimes one after another, birdsong from the street, a motorbike passing outside, a soft exhale
clips.setting: Morning inside Lâm's narrow old-quarter tube house: a ground-floor room with the rolling steel shutter raised, a worn wooden table, a small family altar, sunlight from the street.

clips.speaker: @Mai
clips.line: Ông ơi, cả lớp cháu bảo ông là ông nội ngầu nhất cái Hà Nội này đấy ông ạ!
clips.camera: 35mm medium two-shot slow push-in
beats: Morning inside the narrow tube house, sunlight spilling over the worn wooden table and the small family altar, the rolling steel shutter raised to the street, no person in frame.
@Mai hops onto the stool beside @Lam at the table and tells him the news with a beaming grin, face and lips clearly visible, holding up her glowing phone.
@Mai closes her mouth and nudges her glasses up, eyes sparkling, while @Lam on screen-right lowers his teacup and raises his thick grey eyebrows.
clips.sfx: morning street bustle, birdsong, a teacup clinking on wood, a motorbike horn outside
clips.setting: Morning inside Lâm's narrow old-quarter tube house: a ground-floor room with the rolling steel shutter raised, a worn wooden table, a small family altar, sunlight from the street.

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Ngầu gì, ông chỉ là ông già xe ôm, mai ông còn phải chở cụ Tý đi chợ sớm.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up slow push-in
beats: @Lam sets down his teacup and waves the compliment away with one hand, speaking in a dry husky voice, face and lips clearly visible.
@Lam finishes with a modest shrug and closes his mouth, reaching for a battered green pith helmet on the table.
@Lam puts on the pith helmet to hide a proud little smile, while @Mai at the edge of frame covers her grin with her hand.
clips.sfx: a teacup set on wood, morning street bustle, a rooster crowing far away, birdsong
clips.setting: Morning inside Lâm's narrow old-quarter tube house: a ground-floor room with the rolling steel shutter raised, a worn wooden table, a small family altar, sunlight from the street.

scenes.title: Đôi Mắt Sáng Lại
scenes.location: Phòng bệnh viện mắt sáng sủa buổi sáng, cửa phòng nhìn ra hành lang trắng.
scenes.axis: Giường bệnh giữa khung hình, cửa sổ lớn phía sau; ông Lâm ngồi trên giường bên phải, Mai đứng bên trái giường. Ở cửa phòng: bà Hoa bên trái, ông Khoa bên phải.
scenes.props: Bình giữ nhiệt, lọ hoa cúc trắng, quà của phố cổ (túi cam, rổ rau thơm, hộp cơm), cuộn băng gạc trên khay inox, quạt nan của bà Hoa.
scenes.setting: A bright, clean eye-hospital room in the morning: a white bed, a big window full of sunlight, a small bedside table with a thermos and a vase of daisies.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Một tuần sau, tiền mổ mắt cho ông Lâm do cả phố cổ góp lại, mỗi người một ít, bà Hoa góp nhiều nhất.
clips.camera: 35mm wide shot slow dolly-in
beats: A bright, clean eye-hospital room in the morning, sunlight pouring through the big window over an empty white bed with neatly folded sheets.
The camera glides toward the bedside table crowded with gifts from the old quarter: a thermos, a vase of daisies, a bag of oranges, a basket of fresh herbs and a tin lunchbox.
The camera settles on a woven bamboo hand fan resting on top of the pile of gifts, glowing in a warm sunbeam.
clips.sfx: a soft hospital hum, birdsong outside the window, a curtain rustling in the breeze

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cô y tá từ từ tháo băng, ông Lâm chớp mắt mấy lần, ánh nắng sớm tràn vào căn phòng trắng.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up slow push-in
beats: Sunlight glowing through the big window of the bright eye-hospital room onto a small steel tray holding a roll of white gauze, no person in frame.
@Lam sits up in the white bed with a gauze bandage over his eyes as a nurse in white scrubs, seen from behind, gently unwinds it layer by layer.
The last layer comes away and @Lam blinks several times into the flood of morning light, his once-cloudy left eye now clear, a slow closed-mouth smile spreading.
clips.sfx: the soft rustle of unwinding gauze, birdsong, a gentle hospital hum, a deep slow breath
clips.extras: a nurse in white scrubs seen from behind

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Người đầu tiên ông nhìn thấy rõ là Mai, đứng bên giường, mắt đỏ hoe mà vẫn cười.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot slow rack focus
beats: The bedside of the bright eye-hospital room, sunlight streaming through the big window behind a vase of daisies, everything softly out of focus, no person in frame.
Over @Lam's shoulder, a blurry figure beside the bed slowly sharpens into @Mai, standing in her lavender hoodie with her hands clasped at her chest.
@Mai's eyes are red-rimmed and glistening behind her round glasses as she smiles with closed lips, sunlight haloing her black bob.
clips.sfx: birdsong, a soft sniffle, a faint hospital hum, a curtain swaying

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Cháu ông xinh thế này mà mấy năm nay ông chỉ nhìn thấy lờ mờ, phí quá con ạ.
clips.camera: 35mm medium two-shot slow arc
beats: @Lam looks at @Mai with clear bright eyes and speaks softly in his husky voice, face and lips clearly visible, a teasing smile at the corners of his mouth.
@Lam finishes and closes his mouth, slowly shaking his head with a wistful look as the camera arcs around the sunlit bed.
@Mai shakes with a silent laugh through her tears, lips pressed together, and wipes her eyes under her glasses while @Lam watches her with a warm closed-mouth smile.
clips.sfx: birdsong, a soft sniffle, a curtain swaying in the breeze, distant street horns

clips.speaker: @BaHoa
clips.line: Mắt sáng rồi thì nhớ trả tôi tiền bún chả ba mươi năm nay ông ăn chịu đấy nhé!
clips.camera: 28mm wide shot slow push-in
beats: The doorway of the bright eye-hospital room in morning light, a clean white corridor stretching behind it and sunlight on the tiled floor, no person in frame.
@BaHoa sweeps into the doorway on screen-left with @Khoa beside her on screen-right and calls toward the bed in a brassy teasing voice, face and red lips clearly visible, a woven bamboo fan in hand.
@BaHoa closes her mouth and arches one eyebrow with a smug look, while @Khoa nudges his thick magnifier glasses up his forehead and rolls his eyes.
clips.sfx: heeled sandals clicking on tile, the flap of a bamboo fan, a quiet hospital corridor hum
clips.setting: The doorway of the bright eye-hospital room, a white corridor behind, morning light.

clips.speaker: @Khoa
clips.line: Bà ấy nói đùa đấy, thực ra bà ấy khóc cả đêm qua vì lo cho ông đấy.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up slow push-in
beats: @Khoa leans toward the bed and speaks in a dry nasal deadpan, face and lips clearly visible, one hand cupped beside his mouth as if sharing a secret.
@Khoa finishes, closes his mouth and gives a sly little wink, as @BaHoa's fan stops mid-stroke beside him.
@BaHoa snaps her bamboo fan open in front of her face to hide her reddening cheeks, lips pressed tight, while @Khoa grins with closed lips.
clips.sfx: a bamboo fan snapping open, a stifled sniff, a soft corridor hum, birdsong through a window
clips.setting: The doorway of the bright eye-hospital room, a white corridor behind, morning light.

scenes.title: Găng Tơ Tái Xuất
scenes.location: Cổng Ô Quan Chưởng nắng vàng buổi sáng, quán bún chả bà Hoa, cổng trường đại học và toàn cảnh phố cổ từ trên cao.
scenes.axis: Cổng gạch cổ ở giữa khung hình, chiếc xe máy cũ đỗ dưới vòm cổng; ông Lâm bên trái, cậu thanh niên tiến lại từ bên phải. Ở quán bún chả: bà Hoa bên trái, ông Khoa bên phải.
scenes.props: Chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn pha tròn mạ crôm, mũ cối xanh sờn, tờ hóa đơn giấy không chữ, laptop của Mai chỉ phát sáng.
scenes.setting: Dawn in Hà Nội's old quarter: an ancient brick city gate with a tiled roof, narrow streets of tube houses with green shutters, tangled overhead wires, street vendors with shoulder poles, pink-gold morning light.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm sau, ông Lâm lại đội mũ cối, dựng xe dưới cổng Ô, đợi khách như chưa từng có chuyện gì.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot slow dolly-in
beats: Golden morning light under the ancient brick city gate with its tiled roof, the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp parked in the archway, sparrows hopping on the old bricks, no person in frame.
@Lam walks into frame, settles a battered green pith helmet on his head and sits sideways on the motorbike seat, his clear eyes scanning the waking street.
@Lam folds his arms and leans back on the motorbike under the gate, lips closed in a contented smile, as golden sunlight spills through the arch around him.
clips.sfx: sparrows chirping, a broom sweeping the pavement, a vendor's hand bell, distant motorbike horns

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ở quán bún chả, bà Hoa và ông Khoa lại tranh nhau trả tiền chầu sáng, không ai chịu nhường ai.
clips.camera: 50mm medium close-up two-shot slow push-in
beats: A steel table at the bustling bún chả shop with bowls of noodles, a basket of fresh herbs and a small paper bill with faint unreadable lines in the middle, charcoal smoke drifting, no person in frame.
@BaHoa and @Khoa reach for the bill at the same instant from opposite sides of the table, each pinching one end of it and glaring across at the other.
Neither lets go: @BaHoa narrows her eyes and @Khoa lifts his chin, both lips pressed into stubborn little smiles as grill smoke curls between them.
clips.sfx: pork sizzling on charcoal, a paper bill crinkling, chopsticks clinking, street bustle
clips.setting: Bà Hoa's bustling bún chả shop on an old-quarter street by day: charcoal grills smoking on the pavement, low plastic stools, steel tables, baskets of fresh herbs, warm sunlight through the smoke.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Mai trở lại giảng đường, cô đang viết một ứng dụng mới giúp sinh viên nhận ra các app cho vay lừa đảo.
clips.camera: 24mm wide shot slow crane-down
beats: A bright university campus gate in the morning, tall trees swaying over the entrance path and sunlight dappling the pavement, no person in frame.
@Mai strides through the gate past a few students with her small black backpack, a laptop hugged under one arm, bright eyes behind her round glasses.
@Mai sits on a bench under a tree, opens the laptop on her knees and types fast, its blank screen glowing on her face, lips set in a determined closed-mouth smile.
clips.sfx: birdsong, rustling leaves, bicycle bells, rapid keyboard clicks
clips.setting: A bright university campus gate with tall trees and students passing in the morning.
clips.extras: a few students walking past in the background

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Rồi một cậu thanh niên rụt rè tiến lại gần, nhìn quanh, rồi khẽ hỏi ông có phải là Lâm Rồng không.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot slow push-in
beats: The ancient brick city gate in golden morning light, the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp parked under the arch and a vendor's shoulder pole leaning against the wall, no person in frame.
@Lam sits sideways on the motorbike under the gate as a young man in a delivery jacket approaches from screen-right, glancing left and right, hugging his helmet to his chest.
The young man stops a step away with lips pressed shut and points a hesitant finger at @Lam's right sleeve, eyebrows raised in a silent question, while @Lam looks up at him with calm narrow eyes.
clips.sfx: sparrows chirping, morning traffic hum, shuffling footsteps, a distant vendor's bell
clips.extras: a nervous young man in a delivery jacket approaching

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Cậu nhầm người rồi, tôi chỉ là ông già xe ôm thôi, nhưng cứ ngồi lên, kể tôi nghe chuyện gì.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up slow push-in
beats: @Lam smiles up at the young man and answers in a calm husky voice, face and lips clearly visible, tugging his sleeve down over his forearm.
@Lam finishes warmly, pats the motorbike's back seat twice with his palm, then closes his mouth and tilts his head toward the seat.
@Lam gives a knowing closed-mouth wink as the young man's shoulders relax and he climbs onto the back seat behind him.
clips.sfx: a palm patting a vinyl seat, sparrows chirping, the old engine coughing to life
clips.extras: a nervous young man in a delivery jacket approaching

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Găng tơ đã tái xuất, và phố cổ Hà Nội từ hôm nay lại có một con rồng thức giấc canh giữ.
clips.camera: 24mm aerial drone slow rising pull-back
beats: Golden morning aerial low over the ancient brick city gate with its tiled roof as the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp, carrying two tiny riders, rolls out from under the arch into the street.
The drone rises and pulls back as the little cream motorbike weaves into the narrow streets between tube houses, tangled wires and fluttering laundry, sunlight flaring off its chrome headlamp.
A flock of pigeons sweeps across the frame as the camera soars high above a vast sea of tiled roofs glowing gold, the whole old quarter of Hà Nội waking below in a grand sunlit panorama.
clips.sfx: a rising morning breeze, a flock of pigeons' wings fluttering, distant motorbike horns and bicycle bells, the old engine puttering away
clips.setting: Golden morning aerial over Hà Nội's old quarter: tiled roofs, the ancient brick city gate, a cream motorbike weaving into the streets.
clips.extras: two tiny distant riders on a cream motorbike far below, seen from high above
